title.value: Your GAN is Secretly an Energy-based Model and You Should Use Discriminator Driven Latent Sampling
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Your GAN is Secretly an Energy-based Model and You Should Use Discriminator Driven Latent Sampling

analysis.description: This paper discusses how GANs can be seen as energy-based models and introduces a method called Discriminator Driven Latent Sampling (DDLS) to improve sample quality by sampling in latent space.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on introducing a theoretical framework to understand GANs as energy-based models and the development of a new sampling method.
type.quote: Surprisingly, we find that the implicit energy based model defined jointly by a GAN generator and discriminator takes on a simpler, tractable form when it is written as an energy-based model over the generator’s latent space.

name.justification: The paper's focus is on GANs, discussing their structure and optimization, and proposing enhancements in sampling methods for them.
name.quote: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [3] are state-of-the-art models for a large variety of tasks such as image generation...

name.justification: The paper connects GANs to energy-based models, using this perspective to derive new methods for sampling.
name.quote: In this paper, we show that GANs can be better understood through the lens of Energy-Based Models (EBM).

name.justification: The paper evaluates methods using datasets like CIFAR-10, which are widely used in image synthesis tasks.
name.quote: We evaluate DDLS on both synthetic and real-world datasets qualitatively and quantitatively. On CIFAR-10, DDLS substantially improves the Inception Score...

name.justification: SN-GAN is specifically mentioned as being improved by the DDLS method in the experiments.
name.quote: On CIFAR-10, DDLS substantially improves the Inception Score of an off-the-shelf pre-trained SN-GAN [1] from 8.22 to 9.09...

is_contributed.justification: The paper does not contribute SN-GAN; it is a pre-existing model used for evaluation of DDLS.
is_contributed.quote: On CIFAR-10, DDLS substantially improves the Inception Score of an off-the-shelf pre-trained SN-GAN [1]...

is_executed.justification: The paper reports performance improvements on SN-GAN, indicating it was executed as part of the experiments.

is_compared.justification: SN-GAN is compared against other models using metrics like the Inception Score.
is_compared.quote: This achieves a new state-of-the-art in the unconditional image synthesis setting without introducing extra parameters or additional training.
